AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Controlling Soil Erosion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Water: seedbed pits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.

2. B — Glucose and oxygen

3. C — 100 °C

4. D — newton (N)

5. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

6. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

11. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Controlling Soil Erosion; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conserving Water: seedbed pits; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conserving Wild Animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
